page.title: Grey Labs | Custom software development
page.description: Custom software built around your business. Explore Grey Labs concept studies, services, approach, and project inquiries.

architecture.contract: This page helps business owners decide whether Grey Labs fits their software project. The business outcome is a qualified project inquiry. The primary conversion is Start a project, leading to the inquiry form, whose sending remains disabled until a submission service is configured.
architecture.grid: One 12-column grid within a 1440px maximum content width. Use existing desktop gutters of 48–64px and compact gutters of 20–24px. Reference-specific column spans, full-width frames, and intentional empty columns sit on this grid.
architecture.signatureRule: Derive the opening composition from meridian-01-hero: oversized left-aligned copy occupies the upper-left area of one broad media field, while supporting copy and actions sit lower on the same alignment. Substitute the existing native Operations workspace for photography because the required subject is software. Do not introduce a second decorative motif.
architecture.rhythm: Retain seven substantive sections plus footer. Additional sections would repeat the existing offer. Move from orientation to inspectable concepts, service fit, working approach, delivery steps, practical questions, and inquiry. Alternate broad media, open editorial rows, and prose without wrapping every block in cards. Use existing brand tokens throughout. Assumption: the current reference-lock protocol governs this blueprint's composition mappings; these differ from the older approved mappings recorded in the brief. This phase makes no implementation or artifact changes.

Permit a wider bar to accommodate five required destinations without reducing targets below 44px. sections.purpose: Resolve practical questions before an inquiry.
sections.userQuestion: What should I know before discussing a project?
evidence: The validated brief requires five questions covering software types, getting started, estimates, existing applications, and maintenance.
The current page already implements native disclosures for these topics.

copy.heading: good questions.
body:
What kinds of software do you build?
Custom web applications, business systems, internal tools, and integrations. The starting point is what your business needs the software to do.

How do projects get started?
Tell us about the problem, who will use the software, and what you want to achieve. We can then discuss requirements and a sensible next step.

How are costs and timelines estimated?
Estimates depend on scope, complexity, integrations, and the information available. We clarify requirements and priorities before proposing costs and a timeline.

Can you improve an existing application?
Yes. We can review its current state, identify useful improvements, and discuss a suitable scope of work.

Do you offer ongoing maintenance?
Maintenance and improvements are part of our services. We can discuss the support your application needs and agree on an approach.

responsive: Use content-driven transitions near the existing compact and medium breakpoints. Verify at 320, 390, 768, 1024, and 1440px and at 200% zoom.
Compact layouts reduce simultaneous columns while retaining every project, description, disclosure, field, proof label, and action.
Keep DOM source order consistent with reading and keyboard order. Do not use CSS reordering to move actions away from their explanations.
Native concept interfaces reflow into readable groups. Do not scale down screenshots, crop required controls, or replace interfaces with SVG illustrations.
Preserve concept identification adjacent to each demonstration at every width.
Use existing brand colors and fonts. Apply the validated light-control border token #6B6961 where functional borders require it.
The composition measurements are planning targets derived from the supplied images. Content-driven deviations are stated per section and require visual checking in a later implementation phase.
interactions: Start a project consistently targets #contact; View our work targets #work.
Operations filters update representative local project state without network requests. Workflow step buttons update the adjacent configuration panel and expose selection programmatically.
Previous project and Next project change the selected concept without autoplay, lost focus, or hidden keyboard destinations. Both projects remain available without JavaScript.
Project details and FAQ answers use native disclosures with clear accessible names and independently operable states.

The inquiry form has required name, email, and project description fields, appropriate autocomplete, visible labels, and associated error text. An empty endpoint disables sending. Never transmit form values in the page URL or report unconfirmed success.

Use existing ivory accent treatments for primary actions, selected controls, visible focus, and recurring native interface surfaces. Hover movement is supplemental and never carries required information.

Reveals default to visible in CSS. Prepare hidden states only for individual groups below the viewport. Use IntersectionObserver with threshold 0 and a positive bottom rootMargin near 80px, then unobserve immediately after activation.
Reveals run once and remain finished through reverse scrolling, resize, and rerenders. Skip or finish animations during rapid scrolling so no visited content remains invisible.

Reduced-motion changes and cleanup cancel only owned animations, disconnect owned observers, and restore final visibility. Do not cancel unrelated document animations, transform sticky ancestors, nest reveal transforms, or alter native page scrolling.
acceptanceCriteria: This phase returns a blueprint only. It edits no website files or approved artifacts, installs no dependencies, generates no assets, and starts no server.
The page contains exactly seven substantive sections plus footer, with one primary inquiry intent and no fabricated proof.

Every section uses the recorded exact current-deck reference ID. Later implementation compares desktop and compact geometry against those same images and documents the content adaptations listed here.

The reference mappings in this blueprint differ from the older approved mappings in the project artifacts. Do not claim the existing implementation already matches this new blueprint or silently overwrite historical verification.

Preserve the dependency-free HTML, CSS, and JavaScript architecture and reuse the existing native concept components. The component IDs identify substantial existing interfaces, not new library purchases.

Operations workspace and Connected workflows remain visibly identified as Concept study. Representative records and configurations never imply commissioned work, live integrations, customers, or measured results.

Verify all navigation, project selection, filters, workflow steps, disclosures, and form states by keyboard and pointer. Maintain visible focus, readable contrast, labeled fields, and minimum 44px targets.
Verify an actual hero entrance, work reveal, distinct About reveal, process emphasis, and direct interaction feedback in the browser. A still screenshot cannot establish motion execution.

Rapidly scroll down and up twice, reload at a middle position, resize, and toggle reduced motion during playback. Record browser evidence that every visited section stays visible and reveals do not replay.
Verify content and essential navigation without JavaScript and verify compact interfaces without horizontal page overflow.
Keep inquiry sending disabled while the endpoint is empty. Verify that no submission request, URL transmission, or false success occurs.
Treat prior browser checks as historical evidence only. This Page phase performs no new runtime verification.

The eventual publishing verification note must identify both concept studies, representative demonstration values, the actual inquiry-service configuration, and any remaining hosted-preview or real-device checks.
